question: Does a non-privileged classical controller (stage P go-to + dead-reckoned finale) park on the L1 p0 gate plant at least as well as the RL student?
command: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="" uv run python exp_classical_l1.py --level L1 --episodes 1000 --seed 11 --no-mean-dynamics --json <out>

gate.note: ticks_to_park is the median/p95 time (s) to the success latch over all episodes that reached the success latch, as recorded by the runner; finale entry is the first tick the controller enters dr mode (dead reckoning), truth distance read by the runner only

falsifier.rule: success < 956/1000 on L1 p0, or any collision, refutes

controller.inputs: delayed tag pose + valid, env.imu_w, own previous duties; env.pose / env.vel not read by the controller
controller.phases: search (spin until first fix) -> stage (P go-to to (0,0.55,0), StageGoto law) -> entry (P go-to to (0,0.02,0), enter_goto law, x and yaw held) -> dr (dead reckoning from last fix, PD on yaw with the gyro rate nulled) entered only after a staged car loses the tag; tag lost before staging holds still

axis_signs.probe: exp_classical_l1.py --probe-axes: ch0 +0.5 gives +0.23 m left, ch1 +0.5 gives -0.14 m forward, ch2 +0.5 gives +0.27 rad CCW (seed 0, 4 envs)

controller.how_chosen: Starting from the field StageGoto/enter_goto laws (ugv.autopark). A speed probe on the sim (privileged, probe only) showed the sim has no static deadband and its lateral and yaw response differs from the field fit. Tuning used dev seed 3 with 128-episode runs only, never seed 11: deadband sweeps, yaw kp/kd sweeps, lateral kp/vcap sweeps, entry forward-cap and floor sweeps. Best dev config 73/128 (kp_pos 0.6, kp_yaw 0.5, entry vcap_fwd 0.15, kd_yaw 0.1, GoTo deadbands kept). Tuning did not reach a level that comes near the falsifier.

diagnosis.dominant_failure: collisions with the skid span during the tag-driven entry (lateral error 2 to 5 cm at |y| 0.2 to 0.5 m; the clearance per side is 4.7 cm). Lateral and yaw loops overshoot with 80 ms latency and 30 Hz tags; a faster entry (min_fwd_speed 0.22) gives less time to settle.
diagnosis.finale_geometry: In the L1 sim, valid = in FOV (33.5 deg bearing) or inside 0.30 m of the deck (sim.py valid rule). The 0.40 m tag loss is modelled only from L2 up (under_drone_loss, min_tag_range 0.40). On L1 p0 the dead-reckoned finale only runs when the car leaves the bearing cone, and its entries were all below 0.29 m (max).
diagnosis.bug_found_and_fixed: Gate v1 (run h0002_stage_goto_L1_p0_seed11_v1, 592/1000, 353 collisions, dr entries up to 1.11 m) had a sticky dr phase that could start while the car was still staging at range. Fixed: dr only after staging, hold if the tag drops before staging. v1 kept at .steward/agents/L/out/gate_tuned_seed11.json as a record; the verdict uses v2.
diagnosis.field_record_check: The brief says the stage go-to parked 4/4 on 2026-11-13. calibration/runs/l7/20261113-18*-stage-*/summary.json: toD, front, front3, front4 arrived; front2 and front5 errored (no tag fix); front6 timed out. Later stage runs in the 18xx window (restage, restage-lp, park-0.7, park-0.45) also arrived. Field results are from the car's own tag-fix logs and do not transfer directly to the sim.

not_done: No untuned gate run of the field gains (dev seed 3, 128 episodes: 28/128 with field laws)
No GPU job, no training, no explore.py start/close, no motor or Pi access

gate_v1_record.note: superseded by v2 after the sticky-dr fix
